plugin/ — the moderator module (one directory is one module).

The manifest is bundle-shaped (layout v7): directory
loading ignores the format keys, and `rut pack plugin/` needs them —
so the same directory packs to a v7 compiled `.rutbundle` unchanged,
with linkable deps riding as `.rutc` groups and splice-needed deps
(server's host surface) as source groups.

THE CDN ROW: `pouch` ships as a COMMITTED v7 compiled bundle
(dist/std/pouch.rutbundle, jsDelivr-served at the tag, sha256-pinned
here — the pin is law at the mount door on every load). pouch is a
GENERIC owner, and since the generic-source riding law its bundle
carries the source beside the binary — the plugin's consumer-spelled
`Vec<..>` shapes compile from the bundle at the link. The loader is
the Loader door with the project-local remote (src/lib.rs); the pack
lane takes the same remote (src/main.rs). The TESTS prime an offline
remote from the committed artifacts (dist/std plays the wire), so the
gates never touch the network — and the pack's
rode-along law carries the pouch group inside the plugin's own
bundle, so the packed form stays closed.
